rationale: C06 plausibly supplied concrete machinery for the later Zimbabwe amendment: Treasury designations in consultation with State; coverage of immediate family members, material supporters, and owned or controlled persons; Annex-based blocking; and authority to delist when circumstances no longer warrant inclusion. The child expressly highlights this same combination of added authorities, using closely parallel language. C14 and C18 also contain strong designation-support-delisting templates, but C06 uniquely combines those features with immediate-family coverage.

shared_material.child_excerpt: authority to designate immediate family members of, and those who provide support to, sanctioned persons. It also adds authority to determine that circumstances no longer warrant the blocking
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to be or have been an immediate family member of Charles Taylor ... to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, or technological support ... circumstances no longer warrant the inclusion of a person in the Annex
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive three-part expansion—family members, material supporters, and discretionary delisting—appears in both directives.
